en-US.name: Smart Home Guardian
en-US.summary: Audit and secure your smart home just by talking to Alexa.
en-US.description: Smart Home Guardian runs a simulated security audit of your connected devices, explains weak spots in plain language, fixes them by voice, and locks all entry points on command.
examplePhrases: Alexa, ask smart home guardian to run a security audit
Alexa, tell smart home guardian to lock all entry points

publishingInformation.testingInstructions: Simulation only. Say: run a security audit, then yes, then lock all entry points, then give me a summary.
